svg.title: Pirate dagger floor plans
svg.text: Pirate dagger floor plans
Same hull and room layout for both
loadouts. Systems go into rooms of the
player's choice (GDD 5E): the Cutpurse
has fewer installed, so its Doors and
Medbay rooms stand empty and stripped
(darker, bare floor).
Hijacker: Piloting and Sensors share the
bridge; Doors, Shields, Weapons, Medbay
and the Crew Teleporter each have a
room; Engines and Life Support share the
engine room.
Cutpurse: Piloting, Shields, Weapons,
Crew Teleporter, Engines and Life
Support.
Conduits: a plain ring from the AZC
through the system rooms. The Twinshot
hardpoint is fed twice (a run from the
weapons room and a tap off the ring).
The Sporewing has one spur: the readable
weak point.
Everything is shown intact and powered.
A cut is shown separately, in
mockup-damage-14c.
Airlocks: doors to space, two on each
side of the aft hall. No console sits on
a door tile.
